This post is a template showing the standard format for blog posts. Copy this file and modify it for your own posts.

## Template Structure

### YAML Frontmatter
Every post must have these fields in the header:

- **title**: Main title of your post (required)
- **description**: Short 60-character summary (required, shown in listings)
- **author**: Author name (required)
- **date**: Publication date in YYYY-MM-DD format (required)
- **categories**: List of tags for organization (required)
  - **IMPORTANT**: Always include **"R"** if the post is R-related (needed for R-Bloggers syndication)
  - Other categories: ksTFL, Clinical Programming, Statistics, Data Analysis, etc.
- **image**: Featured image filename (optional)
  - Place image file in the post folder: `posts/YYYY-MM-DD-post-slug/featured.png`
  - Reference in YAML: `image: featured.png`
  - The image appears on the homepage listing and at the top of the post
  - Recommended size: 800x400px or similar (16:9 aspect ratio)
  - Supported formats: PNG, JPG, GIF
- **draft**: Set to true to hide while editing (optional)

### Including Images in Your Post

**Featured Image** (shown on homepage):
- Set in YAML frontmatter: `image: featured.png`
- Place file in same folder as `index.qmd`
- Automatically scaled on homepage

**Images in Post Content**:

Use standard Markdown syntax:
```markdown
![Alt text describing the image](image-filename.png)
```

Example:
```markdown
## Results

Here's a chart showing the performance:

![Performance comparison chart](performance-chart.png)
```

**Best Practices**:
- Use descriptive alt text for accessibility
- Keep images in the same post folder
- Use reasonable file sizes (compress PNGs/JPGs to ~200-500KB)
- Use landscape orientation for wide images
- 16:9 aspect ratio works best for featured images

**Image Folder Structure**:
```
posts/2026-07-15-my-post/
├── index.qmd           (your post file)
├── featured.png        (homepage listing image)
├── chart-01.png        (inline images in post)
└── screenshot.jpg      (more inline images)
```

### For R-Bloggers Syndication

This blog is syndicated on [R-Bloggers](https://www.r-bloggers.com). To ensure your post is picked up:

1. **Include "R" in categories** - This tags it for R-Bloggers RSS feed:
   ```yaml
   categories: [R, ksTFL, Clinical Programming]
   ```

2. **Add R-Bloggers footer** - Include this at the end of your post:
   ```markdown
   ---
   
   *This post was originally published on the KeyStat Solutions R Technical Blog. 
   [Visit R-Bloggers](https://www.r-bloggers.com) to discover more R content.*
   ```

3. **Ensure R relevance** - Posts should contain:
   - R code examples
   - Discussion of R packages or tools
   - R implementation of statistical methods
   - R community topics

### Post Naming Convention

Folder name format: `YYYY-MM-DD-post-slug`

Example:
```
posts/2026-07-15-getting-started-with-ks-tfl/
└── index.qmd
```

## Content Structure

Follow this recommended structure:

1. **Introduction** - Hook and overview with R relevance
2. **Main Content** - Organized sections with ## headings
3. **Code Examples** - Working R examples with explanation
4. **Visuals** - Images, charts, diagrams
5. **Conclusion** - Summary and key takeaways
6. **R-Bloggers Attribution** - Link back to R-Bloggers (see above)
7. **Resources** - Links to related materials

## Writing Tips

### Headings Hierarchy
```markdown
# Title (not used - in YAML)
## Section (main heading)
### Subsection (secondary)
#### Detail (rare)
```

### Code Blocks
Include language for syntax highlighting:

\`\`\`r
# R code
library(tidyverse)
data <- tibble(x = 1:10, y = rnorm(10))
\`\`\`

\`\`\`python
# Python code
import pandas as pd
data = pd.DataFrame({'x': range(10)})
\`\`\`

### Lists
```markdown
- Unordered item 1
- Unordered item 2

1. Ordered item 1
2. Ordered item 2
```

### Emphasis
```markdown
*italic* or _italic_
**bold** or __bold__
~~strikethrough~~
`inline code`
```

### Links
```markdown
[Link text](https://example.com)
[Internal link](../2026-07-07-advanced-ks-tfl/index.html)
[Link to section](#section-heading)
```

### Images
```markdown
![Alt text](images/filename.png)
```

### Tables
```markdown
| Column 1 | Column 2 |
|----------|----------|
| Row 1    | Value    |
| Row 2    | Value    |
```

### Callout Boxes
```markdown
::: {.callout-note}
This is a note callout
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
This is a warning callout
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
This is a helpful tip
:::

::: {.callout-important}
This is important information
:::
```

## SEO Guidelines

### Description
- Keep to ~60 characters
- Include main topic
- Write for humans, not search engines

### Categories
- Use 2-4 relevant tags
- Consistent with existing posts
- Examples: R, ksTFL, Tutorial, Advanced, Clinical Programming

### Title
- Clear and descriptive
- Include keywords naturally
- Avoid click-bait

## Publishing Workflow

1. **Create folder** with date and slug
2. **Write content** in index.qmd
3. **Set draft: true** while editing
4. **Add images** to images/ subfolder (optional)
5. **Render locally**: `quarto preview`
6. **Review** in browser
7. **Remove draft: true**
8. **Commit and push**

## Before Publishing

- [ ] Spell check content
- [ ] Test all code examples
- [ ] Verify all links work
- [ ] Check image display
- [ ] Review formatting
- [ ] Update date to today
- [ ] Remove draft: true
- [ ] Add meaningful description
- [ ] Select appropriate categories

## File Structure Example

```
posts/2026-07-15-my-topic/
├── index.qmd              # Main post file
├── featured.png           # Featured image (600x400px)
└── images/

    └── code-output.svg
```

## Troubleshooting

**Post not appearing**: Check that `draft: true` is removed from YAML

**Images not showing**: Use relative paths like `images/file.png`

**Code not highlighted**: Specify language: \`\`\`r or \`\`\`python

**Formatting looks wrong**: Run `quarto render` to rebuild
